sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT o.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_arv_orders o
WHERE o.date_activated >= :startDate
  AND o.date_activated < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND o.voided = 0
  AND o.days_on_drugs IS NOT NULL
  AND o.days_on_drugs > 0
  AND o.days_on_drugs < 90
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = o.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
